body:
## Context

1.11.0 arc follow-up (#540 rounds 4-5, #545). The opencode and pi handoff adapters now contain the deny-set with the predicate their own rails-in-force resolution keys on — ticketStoreExists including the ADLC_TICKET_STORE/ADLC_TICKETS external-store override — plus an init latch (once a root is seen initialized it stays armed for the plugin process's life). codex and claude-code still guard on bare existsSync('.adlc') (codex adlc-handoff-gate.mjs:1073-era guard; CC adlc-hook.mjs:2217-era guard), which carries BOTH defects the arc fixed elsewhere:
1. Upgrade trap: a directory CONTAMINATED by the pre-1.11 bug (has .adlc/.deny-store + markers but NO ticket store) reads as opted-in — the bug's artifacts vouch for the gate that contains it, and the repo stays denied.
2. (Verify per adapter) external-store worktrees: if the adapter's rails path honors an external store with no local .adlc, a bare-.adlc handoff guard silently under-enforces relative to rails.
Do NOT repeat #540 round-5's fail-open: never AND a local-.adlc clause onto the store predicate — use EXACTLY the predicate rails-in-force keys on. Deletion route note (#540 round 10): shell rm of the store is refused as path_protected_shell, but STRUCTURED writes/deletes naming the store (path/target/filePath shapes) are allowed — the latch must be regression-tested against the structured route.

## What to change

Per adapter (codex, claude-code): switch the handoff containment guard to the adapter's own rails-in-force store predicate; add the init latch (never arms an uninitialized dir, never disarms). Port the regression shapes from plugins/adlc-opencode/test/handoff-deny.test.mjs and plugins/adlc-pi/test/handoff-deny.test.mjs: (a) contaminated dir (deny artifacts only, no store) stays inert across many calls + shell; (b) external absolute store with no local .adlc arms, denies past the band, and writes the marker; (c) structured deletion of the store below the band does not disarm (both store layouts).

## Acceptance criteria

1. Contaminated-dir regression green on both adapters. verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-codex/hooks/test/*.test.mjs plugins/adlc-claude-code/hooks/test/*.test.mjs` exits 0 with the new tests present.
2. External-store regression green on both (or a documented finding that the adapter's rails path does not support external stores, making the case vacuous — state which). verify: same command; the PR body names which branch held.
3. Structured-deletion latch regression green on both, both layouts. verify: same command.
4. No adapter ANDs a local-.adlc clause onto the store predicate. verify: reviewer confirms against the diff; the drift/threshold source-assertion suites stay green (`node --test packages/context-handoff/adapter-test/*.test.mjs` exits 0).
title: codex + claude-code: align handoff containment on the rails-in-force predicate with an init latch
